title: Each stream has its usual volume each month
Reason Needed: Compare months only once each stream has reached its usual volume.

title: Recent months are flagged until they are complete
One value per point, time and thing measured
Reason Needed: State how repeated values are handled.

title: Result holds a measurement, not a lab status
Reason Needed: Leave lab status rows out of calculations.

title: Results can go straight into a calculation
Reason Needed: Count below-limit results with a stated method. Never drop them.

title: Each name means one thing
Reason Needed: Join on the code, never the name.

title: Detection limits are stable within what was measured
Reason Needed: Keep trends to one stable limit.

title: pH is usually between 4 and 11
Reason Needed: Review extreme values before relying on them.

title: Water temperature is between -2 and 40 degrees
Reason Needed: Review extreme values before relying on them.

title: No result is over 1,000 times the usual level
Reason Needed: Show a median beside any average.

title: Above-range results are treated as ceilings
Open sampling points have a result in the window
Each sampling point has its own label
Reason Needed: Join on the point's code, never its label.

title: Coordinates are inside the North West
Reason Needed: Show stand-in locations separately, never on a map.

title: Below-limit share is within what a model can handle
Reason Needed: Use a method built for censored targets.

title: Samples cover the whole week
Reason Needed: Limit predictions to the hours the data covers.

title: Enough repeat samples per point
Reason Needed: Train only on points with regular history.

title: Clock times are real times, not defaults
Reason Needed: Leave time of day out for affected streams.
